game_moneyline_spread#cfbd_fcs_coverage.rationale: Not only a source question: if CFBD advanced metrics/SP+ are FBS-only (widely documented), the catalog has no defined rating input for FCS opponents used by FCSGAME, FBS-vs-FCS spreads and HIGHSCORE.
game_moneyline_spread#cfbd_fcs_coverage.catalog_action: Author an own score-based FCS rating input (Elo-style margin rating, home/neutral flags, uncertainty) and record which CFBD endpoints cover FCS by season as its fallback trigger.

game_moneyline_spread#d3_score_source.rationale: The D3 margin model input is defined; what is unknown is the completeness of free D3 score sources (NCAA, D3football.com, Massey) and their neutral/playoff flags across 2010-2025.

game_moneyline_spread#injury_feed_gap.rationale: cfb.injuries is defined but no official per-player report exists in most conferences; a usable history requires prospective timestamped capture of beat-reporter and team releases.

game_moneyline_spread#ml_ot_tie_unstated.rationale: The sampled KXNCAAFGAME/SPREAD rules (full, untruncated) only say 'official final result' and never address overtime, ties or suspended games, unlike CSGAME/D3GAME; only Kalshi can confirm.

game_moneyline_spread#pace_attachment.rationale: cfb.pace/cfb.drives are attached but their role (primary vs secondary) and their overlap with offense_style are undeclared, so the catalog carries a possibly double-counted input definition.
game_moneyline_spread#pace_attachment.catalog_action: Define non-overlapping scopes for cfb.pace, cfb.drives and offense_style (possession count vs play-style efficiency), declare each one's role for margin variance, and specify the heteroskedasticity test that confirms it.

game_moneyline_spread#spread_ot_treatmen.rationale: The sampled KXNCAAFSPREAD text 'wins by more than X points ... official final result' is silent on overtime; whether OT margin counts can only be settled by Kalshi wording or clarification.

game_stat_props#air_yards_coverage.rationale: Depth of target, pressure and personnel are defined inputs, but free sources lack confirmed full-FBS coverage; PFF/SIS are paid, so the yardage profile must rely on a proxy.

game_stat_props#cfbd_receiver_field.rationale: Team receiving yards are defined; the gap is whether CFBD play-by-play receiver/yards fields are complete since 2014 and reconcile to official box scores, a source-quality check.

game_stat_props#official_provider.rationale: The sampled rules settle on the 'official final result' without naming a statistics provider or Source Agency; which box score governs one-yard disputes is up to Kalshi to state.

game_stat_props#other_stat_props_rules.rationale: KXNCAAFTEAMTD text does not say whether defensive/special-teams TDs count, and RSHTD/RECTD samples are truncated after the 2-point clause; only fuller Kalshi text can settle it.

game_stat_props#receiving_yards_definiti.rationale: The definition of receiving yards (negative yards, laterals, trick plays) is a documented NCAA statistical rule the author can look up; the catalog currently relies on unread domain knowledge.
game_stat_props#receiving_yards_definiti.catalog_action: Read the NCAA Football Statisticians' Manual and author cfb receiving-yards definition (laterals, negative plays, backward passes, 2-point exclusion) with its equivalence to team pass yards on completions.

game_stat_props#rush_attempt_rules.rationale: KXNCAAFTEAMRSHATT is TITLE_ONLY with NO_MARKETS_LISTED in the sample, so whether sacks/kneels and overtime attempts count cannot be read until Kalshi lists or clarifies it.

game_stat_props#situational_effect_untes.rationale: Rest, travel, rivalry and motivation are explicitly not defined as inputs anywhere for this archetype; a candidate mechanism the catalog lacks rather than a data problem.
game_stat_props#situational_effect_untes.catalog_action: Author shared cfb situational inputs (days rest, travel distance/time zones, rivalry flag, lookahead/trap flag) with sources, and attach them to passing volume as secondary with the residual-regression test.

game_total#crew_assignment_timing.rationale: Officiating crew is a defined input and conferences do post assignments, but the timing of postings relative to market close must be recorded prospectively for a season.

game_total#explosive_dispersion.rationale: The catalog has not chosen a definition of opponent-adjusted explosiveness (IsoPPP vs 20+ yard play rate) for total tails; an unsettled input definition.
game_total#explosive_dispersion.catalog_action: Author a single cfb explosiveness definition (pick IsoPPP or 20+ yard rate, opponent adjustment and shrinkage for thin FBS connectivity) plus non-offensive TD rate, with the tail-calibration backtest as acceptance test.

game_total#highscore_universe.rationale: KXNCAAFHIGHSCORE says 'a Division I game (including overtime)' without saying whether D-I vs D-II/NAIA games count; the qualifying game set is Kalshi's to define.

game_total#situational_totals_effect.rationale: No input exists for rest, lookahead, rivalry or title stakes on tempo/scoring; the catalog lacks the mechanism definition, not merely data about it.
game_total#situational_totals_effect.catalog_action: Attach the shared cfb situational inputs (rest, rivalry, lookahead, conference-title stakes flags) to game_total as secondary, with definitions and the residual-regression test on non-market expected totals.

game_total#total_ot_treatment.rationale: The full sampled KXNCAAFTOTAL text is silent on overtime though the title says 'Full Game' and HIGHSCORE states 'including overtime'; OT inclusion awaits Kalshi wording.

game_total#wind_proxy_validity.rationale: Stadium wind exposure is defined, but no public forecast archive exists, so forecast-vs-observed calibration requires forward capture of forecast vintages at stadiums.

overtime#fcs_line_score_source.rationale: The FCS overtime/tie curve is the same defined mechanism as FBS; the gap is that no FCS period line-score source with OT periods back to 2005 is confirmed.

overtime#late_decision_causality.rationale: The kneel-to-overtime vs out-of-time label used by the decision profile has no operational definition; the catalog must define how it is derived from play-by-play.
overtime#late_decision_causality.catalog_action: Author a rule-based labelling definition of late-game decisions (clock, timeouts, score, play type) for the decision profile, with a hand-labelled 200-state validation spec.

overtime#mostot_scope.rationale: Scope of KXNCAAFMOSTOT is established, but the truncated sample does not say how a game halted by weather during overtime counts; only Kalshi can define it.

overtime#ot_history_source.rationale: Long-overtime counts and per-period continuation rate are defined quantities; the obstacle is unconfirmed CFBD/NCAA line-score coverage for FCS and pre-2005 games.

overtime#ot_rule_history.rationale: NCAA overtime rule changes (2019 two-point plays from 5th OT, 2021 two-point from 2nd OT and alternating attempts from 3rd) are lookup facts the author has not verified.
overtime#ot_rule_history.catalog_action: Read the NCAA football rule-change history 1996-2026 and author cfb.ot_rule_regime with the first season of each OT procedure and its effect on continuation probability.

overtime#small_sample_tail.rationale: The continuation mechanism (two-point rate model) is defined; the history of 6+ OT games is inherently a handful of cases, a coverage limit no research can enlarge.

quarter_and_half_sides#period_matchup_ga.rationale: No input captures period-specific structure (scripted openers, halftime adjustments); the catalog must either define it or record it as noise with evidence.
quarter_and_half_sides#period_matchup_ga.catalog_action: Define a period-share residual input per team (or explicitly declare it excluded) and specify the cross-season persistence test that decides between attaching it and documenting it as noise.

quarter_and_half_sides#period_tie_payout.rationale: Complete KXNCAAF1Q-4Q/1H text has no tie clause; a tied quarter resolving both sides No is inferred, not stated, unlike KXNCAAF1HWINNER's explicit Tie strike.

quarter_and_half_totals#btts_rules_missi.rationale: KXNCAAF1QBTTS/2QBTTS/3QBTTS have no listed market or rules text, so whether safeties, defensive TDs or 2-point returns count as scoring cannot be read.

quarter_and_half_totals#drive_clock_vint.rationale: Period line scores and drive clocks are defined inputs; known inconsistency of CFBD drive-boundary clock fields (last drive of half) is a source-quality limitation.

quarter_and_half_totals#garbage_threshol.rationale: The quarter garbage-time thresholds are asserted from memory of published practice; the SP+/CFBD methodology is public and can be read to fix the definition.
quarter_and_half_totals#garbage_threshol.catalog_action: Read the published SP+ / CFBD garbage-time methodology, author the exact per-quarter margin thresholds (and any FCS/regime variant) in the definition, and specify a +/-7 sensitivity check.

quarter_and_half_totals#opponent_matchup.rationale: No definition exists for a period-specific offense-vs-defense matchup input; the catalog must define it from play-by-play or explicitly exclude it.
quarter_and_half_totals#opponent_matchup.catalog_action: Author a period-specific opponent-adjusted efficiency definition (by quarter/half from CFBD PBP) or record its exclusion, with the out-of-sample log-loss test as the decision rule.

quarter_and_half_totals#quarter_total_no.rationale: Whether quarter-structural mechanisms (scripted openers, two-minute drills) belong in the catalog is undecided; the share-of-total model is not yet justified as sufficient.
quarter_and_half_totals#quarter_total_no.catalog_action: Decide and document the quarter-total mechanism set: either author scripted-opener/two-minute-drill inputs or record the share-of-game-total model as sufficient with the 5-season log-loss comparison spec.

quarter_and_half_totals#team_total_perio.rationale: KXNCAAF1HTEAMTOTAL sets first-half scope but its suspension handling is unstated in the sample, and no other period team-total series text is available.
